summary.text: Chris Ford is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Michael Kreun.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served on the Blaine City Council since 2024 and previously spent 21 years as a firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Ford said in the survey that he has worked for eight years as a paraprofessional at Blaine High School.
He said that before moving to Blaine he was a firefighter for 21 years, including 10 years as president of his local International Association of Fire Fighters union and 13 years as a fire captain.
Ford listed affordability, public safety, and investment in education as his main campaign messages, and said he is especially concerned about health insurance costs.
His Democratic primary was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
